coverage: Unified versioned reason-code vocabulary: system, version, ruleset and status; the four semantic classes (missing, refused, uncertain, not-applicable); five codes with canonical display and class; measurement provenance sources mapped onto codes (recorded sources are not reasons, all missing sources have a code, all recorded sources none); programme answer absence reasons mapped onto the same codes and classes; a single reasonForField mapping for both kinds of free-text field; coded FHIR artefacts (reason CodeableConcept coding and a coded method for reported); provenance and absence maps keyed by field/question id; the MIS payload reasons section (omitted when none); the summary reason-codes line; and the mapping applied to the real demo summary, MIS mapped payload, FHIR document and FHIR example download.
